name: [Equip] The API is turning people away (429)
message:
The API answered 429 five or more times in ten minutes.

RateLimitMiddleware (backend/app/middleware/rate_limit.py) counts a signed-in person by person (100/min) with a shared ceiling of 600/min for all signed-in traffic from one IP; anonymous requests and the per-prefix buckets (/cohorts, /scripture/, certificates, invitations) are counted by IP. The counters live in each function instance's memory.

Look at the sample lines: one path repeating is a client loop or a scraper; many paths from one school or church is a class outgrowing the ceiling.

The status code is only in the access line text ("api: METHOD path STATUS ms"); @proxy.statusCode is nearly empty.

Notify: @supportequip@gmail.com
